note: Campground in Eagle Point Provincial Park on the North Saskatchewan River, 6 km east of Drayton Valley off Hwy 22, run by Brazeau County; canoeing, fishing and swimming, with the Hillside & Hilltop trail system nearby. ATVs are not allowed in the campground. --Claude
